'''Roon Neele''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He acted as an attaché for the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Angral]] during the Sith-martial law occupation of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] immediately after the [[Sacking of Coruscant]].
